Newsbeat - our latest news

Findings of external review to be publicly released in August

The findings of the independent external review into the tragic landslide at Mount Maunganui Beachside Holiday Park on 22 January 2026 will be publicly released by 21 August 2026.

Update on Mauao landslide reactivation

Recent monitoring has confirmed renewed movement within the main landslide area on Mauao above the Mount Maunganui Beachside Holiday Park.

Mauao landslide update

Tauranga City Council advises that the monitoring alarms on Mauao have activated again today.

A message from Charlie Rahiri, Recovery Manager about the landslips on Mauao overnight

The landscape on Mauao continues to change.

View all news

We’re getting the heart of our city pumping

Over the next 10 years, our city centre is set to transform into an exciting, vibrant place that our community can feel proud of, and where people from near and far will want to visit, live, work, learn and play. 

Find out more
